infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Flash ERP uses the camera to scan product barcodes and capture fuel delivery evidence photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Flash ERP accesses photos to attach receipts to expense claims.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Flash ERP to access the camera for barcode scanning.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Flash ERP to select receipt and leave evidence images.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Flash ERP to photograph expense receipts.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Flash ERP to record your location when clocking in or out.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Allow Flash ERP to use Face ID to unlock the app.
